standard: RÖHM DURO-M, cylindrical centre mount DIN 6350
description: Nine-body RÖHM DURO-M three-jaw geared scroll chuck assembly: one-piece chuck body, separate rear cover, scroll plate carrying an Archimedean spiral thread on its face and a bevel crown ring on its back, three installed outward-stepped BB jaws with underside arc teeth engaged in the spiral (with the real 1/3-pitch stagger between jaws), and three straight-bevel radial drive pinions meshing the crown ring (shared pitch-cone apex on the chuck axis, tan(delta)=Zw/Zp). The 12 catalog_index values map one-to-one to official DIN 6350 size rows (74 through 630); jaw_open_fraction only selects an operating state inside the published A1 chucking range. Catalog envelopes, mounting dimensions, jaw envelopes and key-square sizes are exact; internal tooth counts, cone angles, thread section and clearances are derived proportions documented in NOTES.md. The supplied chuck key and alternate loose jaw sets are operating accessories and are not installed assembly bodies.
source: RÖHM Lathe Chucks catalogue (DURO-M product, dimensions, chucking ranges and jaw dimensions), PDF pages 19-32 / printed pages 3041-3061: https://www.roehm.biz/fileadmin/user_upload/produkte/PG3_Handspannfutter/en_03_Lathe_chucks_FINISH_231121_en.pdf ; product mechanism description: https://www.roehm.biz/en/duro-m/
